title: File:Second entrance gate to the Kareng Ghor- Ahom Raja's Palace in Assam.jpg
author: Joli Rumi
description: One of the entrance gates to the Kareng Ghor- Ahom Raja's Palace situated at Garhgaon which is around 15 kms away from Sivasagar Town in Assam. The present multistoried edifice was built by king Rajeswar Singha in 1752 AD.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
